data.exact_reserve_text: The 2023 year was impacted by prior year reserve releases of GBP 42.6m as a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated. In addition there was a GBP 4.4m bad debt release on the prior year reserves following a review of bad debt held in the year. Partially offsetting this were GBP 9.4m of net catastrophe losses.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2023 the syndicate recorded material favourable development on prior year claims reserves, described in the report as prior year reserve releases of GBP 42.6m, together with a GBP 4.4m bad debt release; these were partially offset by GBP 9.4m of net catastrophe losses. Notable prior-year drivers cited in the report include COVID-19 related losses (largely in 2020 and subsequent deteriorations), various natural catastrophe losses (Derecho storms, Hurricane Laura, Hurricane Ian), the South Africa riots and impacts from the Russia-Ukraine conflict. The syndicate also transacted an LPT for its UK Motor PPO in March 2023 which materially reallocated the PPO liability to reinsurers.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development value taken from Managing Agent narrative which states 'prior year reserve releases of GBP 42.6m' - the note does not explicitly label this amount as gross or net of reinsurance. A gross movement note exists (technical provisions reconciliation) but that shows total movement for the year (including current year) and therefore was not used per instructions. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 42) but OCR/formatting in the supplied text prevented reliable extraction of per-cell cumulative estimates for diagonal comparison; therefore the narrative figure was used. If a gross PYD figure is required strictly from the provision movement note or triangle, further extraction from the full PDF (high-quality text) is recommended.
